notes.notes:

Hopefully this will fix and address this issue! Fingers crossed.

notes.title: The Autumn Sale is HERE!
notes.notes:
If any of you were looking to grab [b]To Aerthen[/b], there is no better time than the present! Like many other incredible RPGs, you can enjoy this lighthearted adventure to save the world of Aerthen at a discount!

This was the MAJOR motivation force behind pushing me to getting those Achievement implemented before the end of November. I wanted those (achievements)--along with all other known bugs and issues--fixed before the Autumn Sale started. That way, the influx of potential new players would have access to the absolute best version of To Aerthen.

Thank you for all of the praise and support, everyone! Keep those Wishlists coming!

notes.title: An ACHIEVEMENT draws near!
notes.notes:
You read it right, folks: with the following update applied today, on [b]November 1st, 2023[/b], To Aerthen at long last has [b]Achievements[/b]!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/F9xhin9WgAAqmoS?format=jpg&name=medium[/img]


[u][b]There are 30 in tota[/b][/u]l, and correspond to relatively simple progression milestones such as defeating a particular boss or reaching a certain point in the story. There's nothing outrageous, so nabbing them all shouldn't be all THAT hard!

Aside from that major addition to the game (which will undoubtedly give many potential players additional incentive to see their journey through to the end), several balancing adjustments have been made to the game as well, alongside the correction of spelling errors and the clarification of the effects of certain equipment.

notes.title: October Patch
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Aertheners! 

Spooky season is here at last, and with it comes another (relatively minor) patch for To Aerthen!

[b]-Several spelling mistakes were fixed.
-Plug-ins were rearranged and tweaked to hopefully offer a smoother gaming experience.
-Several maps were edited.
-Fixed some tile passability issues.
-Some enemies were buffed.
-Other minor fixes.[/b]

Thanks so much for supporting me and my work! I hope you're all enjoying the game! =)

notes.title: Post-Release Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug that would softlock the player if they attempted to leave Henpur Village as animals.

-Strengthened the magical capabilities of some enemies.

-Fixed several collision detection issues.

-Added several NPCs the the first two villages that help further explain some of the game's more basic concepts.

-Players can now determine what type an enemy is based on their name during combat: 
[i][b]* ENEMY NAME *[/b] means the enemy is a flying type.
[b][ ENEMY NAME ] [/b]means the enemy is an armored type. [/i]

notes.title: Post Patch 3
notes.notes:
-Buffed the magical abilities of several early-game enemies.

-Decreased the potency of Recover 1 and 2 (AOE healing abilities).

-Fixed several mapping and collision errors.

-Added to the game's Credits.




Thanks for playing, everyone! Hope you're enjoying the experience. =)

notes.title: Post Patch 2
notes.notes:
-Updates game's NW.js files.
-Fixed problem caused by previous update that caused game to freeze if exiting through the title screen.

I apologize for the back-to-back updates! Still ironing everything out.

This SHOULD be it for a while, but if any major issues are encountered please let me know!

notes.title: Post-Release Patch
notes.notes:
-Buffed several early-game enemies.
-Fixed some spelling mistakes.
-[b]Hopefully addressed[/b] an issue where the game would sometimes crash at random points. 

NOTE: Please save as often as possible to prevent any unnecessary loss of data/progress!
